# Brisk Teaching

> Free AI-powered tools for teachers to streamline lesson planning, grading, content creation, and student feedback across all subjects and grade levels.

Brisk Teaching provides a comprehensive suite of 30+ free AI tools designed to reduce teacher workload and enhance classroom instruction. The platform integrates with Google and Microsoft applications, offers curriculum intelligence features aligned with district standards, and supports multiple languages including English, Spanish, Hindi, Chinese, and Portuguese.

## Key Topics

- AI lesson planning
- Student feedback generation
- Quiz and assessment creation
- Presentation maker
- Batch grading
- Reading level adjustment
- Curriculum intelligence
- Google Slides integration
- Teacher productivity
- Personalized learning
- Writing assessment
- Academic integrity
- Chrome extension
- Brisk Boost
- Brisk Next

## Core AI Tools

- [AI Lesson Plan Generator](https://www.briskteaching.com/ai-tools/lesson-plan-generator): AI-powered lesson plan generator for any subject, grade, and language
- [Give Feedback](https://www.briskteaching.com/give-feedback): AI feedback generator for batch grading and student assignment evaluation
- [AI Quiz Generator](https://www.briskteaching.com/ai-tools/quiz-generator): Free AI quiz maker creating assessments in Google Forms, Docs, and Kahoot
- [Free AI Presentation Maker](https://www.briskteaching.com/ai-tools/presentation-maker): AI tool generating customizable Google Slides and PowerPoint presentations from content
- [Create Anything Tool](https://www.briskteaching.com/ai-tools/create-anything-tool): Versatile AI tool creating vocab lists, escape rooms, and unlimited teaching resources
- [Create Instructional Materials](https://www.briskteaching.com/create-instructional-materials): Tool converting resources into complete lesson sets with presentations and quizzes
- [Change Reading Level](https://www.briskteaching.com/change-reading-level): AI text leveler and translator adjusting content for accessibility and multilingual support
- [Inspect Writing](https://www.briskteaching.com/inspect-writing): Writing assessment tool inspecting student work and tracking academic integrity

## Advanced Features & Planning

- [Curriculum Intelligence](https://www.briskteaching.com/curriculum-intelligence): AI system embedding district standards and adopted materials into classroom resources
- [Brisk Next](https://www.briskteaching.com/brisk-next): Advanced planning tool for assignment, adaptation, and feedback based on student data
- [Brisk Boost](https://www.briskteaching.com/briskboost): Interactive educational content delivery tool for student engagement and learning
